subject: Co-innovation sandbox exchange — Datadog / Grafana / Redwood
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Mike Jensen <mike@datadog.com>, Anna Petrov <anna@grafana.com>, partners@obs-ops.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Co-innovation sandbox exchange — Datadog / Grafana / Redwood

Hi Mike / Anna / team,

Quick note following the summit discussions — Redwood would like to propose a short, focused "co-innovation sandbox exchange" where we swap limited test workloads and run a joint evaluation over 4 weeks. Goal: validate an integrated observability flow for LLM inference (metrics + traces + structured logs) and produce a partner-facing integration guide.

High-level ask:
- Redwood provides a small hosted test tenant and a reproducible trace/metric generator for LLM serving.
- Datadog / Grafana provide sandbox access, a small set of dashboards, and one engineer for troubleshooting.
- ObservOps can run short operational playbooks and document any integration gaps.

Attachments: redwood-coinnovation-brief.pdf (short scope + success criteria), sandbox-ops-matrix.xlsx (roles & time estimates).

Proposed timeline: 4-week lab starting mid-August with a demo and a one-pager at close. Commercials: lightweight cost share for sandbox infra — details in the attached MAP draft.

Can you confirm interest and an initial sync time next week?

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

[Attachment: redwood-coinnovation-brief.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: sandbox-ops-matrix.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Anna Petrov <anna@grafana.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Mike Jensen <mike@datadog.com>, partners@obs-ops.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Co-innovation sandbox exchange — Datadog / Grafana / Redwood

Ben — thanks for the clear proposal. Grafana is interested. A few quick clarifications:

1) Sandbox access: we can provision a Grafana Cloud sandbox with a weeks-long trial API key and a demo Loki tenant.
2) Data types: are you planning to push raw traces, or aggregated traces + logs? For dashboard parity we prefer spans + structured logs.
3) Security/PII: we'll need to confirm that generator output is synthetic (no real user data).

I'll volunteer our integrator lead (Anna) for the technical sync — 30m should be enough to align on ingest paths and dashboard templates. Proposed times: Tue 27 Jul 10:00-10:30 PT or Wed 28 Jul 13:00-13:30 PT.

Also attaching a short checklist we use for sandboxes (I'll share after the sync).

Best,
Anna
Anna Petrov
Partner Solutions, Grafana Labs
anna@grafana.com
